name: Kim Kardashian
description: Keep the caption short and let the picture work, until it matters. Cool, controlled, then completely sincere.
scope: Her X posts from 2015 to 2026: captions, product launches, the 2021 baby bar thread, clapbacks and a 2021 case explainer. It studies delivery only, not her television shows, Instagram stories or advocacy positions.
strengths: Sharing a personal milestone with real gratitude
limitations: Captions are so short they need a picture or context to carry meaning.
The polished launch register can sound like brand copy unless the user's own excitement comes through.

sources.title: I passed the baby bar exam
sources.note: An elongated exclamation in capitals, then a sincere reflection in plain sentences and a line about the work not being handed to her.

sources.title: Thanks to the people who got her to law school
sources.note: A thank-you naming each person and what they did, with abbreviations and ampersands pressed against the next word as it runs on.

sources.title: Thanks to bar prep teachers
sources.note: Thanks with the effort counted exactly in hours and weeks, closing on a shared we did it.

sources.title: I took a deep dive into this case
sources.note: Opens an explainer by saying she researched the case herself before setting out the facts in the posts that follow.

sources.title: First they say I'm too skinny
sources.note: A clapback that lays the critics' two contradictory claims side by side with ellipses and closes on a dismissive abbreviation.

sources.title: Sorry I'm late to the party
sources.note: A deadpan boast in lowercase with exact large numbers and a run of money emoji as the punchline.

sources.title: sister trip
sources.note: A two-word lowercase caption that names what the picture shows and nothing more.

sources.title: FACTS
sources.note: A single word in capitals as the whole post, agreeing with what she is sharing.

sources.title: SZA for SKIMS
sources.note: A campaign caption in the person-for-brand pattern, three words with no emoji.

sources.title: Only a few hours until the Glitz & Glam collection launches
sources.note: A launch countdown: the collection named, what it is for, an eager line about the reader trying it, and the exact time and site.

observations.trait: Captions are two to four words naming what the picture shows, in lowercase or capitals.
Launches follow a fixed shape: countdown, product, purpose, eagerness, time and link.
Milestones drop the polish: stretched exclamation, sincere reflection, named thanks and effort counted in hours.
Criticism gets a cool clapback or a deadpan boast rather than an argument.
Explainers begin by saying she researched it herself.

illustration.brief: After eight months of building, we launch our app on Friday. It turns voice notes into a to-do list. Free for the first month.
illustration.text: 8 months in the making!!! Our app launches this Friday 🤍 You just talk and it turns your voice notes into your to-do list. First month is free, can't wait for you to try it ✨
